Package com.here.platform.location.core.mapmatching.model

Class HMMForwardState<O,V>

java.lang.Object
com.here.platform.location.core.mapmatching.model.HMMForwardState<O,V>
Type Parameters:
O - Observation type
V - Vertex (road element) type
public final class HMMForwardState<O,V> extends Object

This is an experimental API. It may be removed or changed from one version to the next.

Minimal forward state required to continue the HMM algorithm from the last processed observation.

Used as the hand-off payload for distributed processing: after node N finishes a batch, it extracts this context from HMMMatcherState (as an Option) and transfers it to node N+1, which resumes matching without requiring the full observation history.

candidates and costs are index-aligned, must have the same length, and must be non-empty (at minimum one

invalid reference 
MatchCandidate.unmatched
sentinel when no road candidates exist).
